assert 'Publishing requires explicit user authorization.' in a
assert '[spec](spec.md)' in a
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], text=True).splitlines() == ['spec.md']
print('Rule consistency and change scope checks passed.')
PY"
